translations.web: He reigned forty-one years in Jerusalem. His mother’s name was Maacah the daughter of Abishalom.
translations.bsb: and he reigned in Jerusalem forty-one years. His grandmother’s name was Maacah daughter of Abishalom.
translations.kjv: And forty and one years reigned he in Jerusalem. And his mother's name was Maachah, the daughter of Abishalom.
